error[ZC-E0307]: a job's stored records contradict each other
  cause  /job-status/train-7 has ended but /job-runs/train-7 does not exist
  fix    restore the missing record; never delete a run or status (it runs the job again)
  more   zcube explain E0307 · rerun with --verbose for the full cause chain
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigcube/errors/E0307.html
